name: Guangdong Lingxiao Pump Industry Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Lingxiao Pump Industry Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of water pumps in China and internationally. The company offers s.s horizontal single and multistage pump, and s.s vertical multistage pump; fitness and entertainment pumps, including hydromassage bathtub, SPA, circulation, swimming pool, air blower, and heater pumps; clean water, sewage, and well submersible pump, as well as submerge pump; no-self priming series, self priming series, and auto booster pump; inline pump series; and standard motor services.
